description: Came here for dinner on a Monday night at 6pm. It’s a great location and easy to get to whether you are staying on Elephantine island or on mainland. Our motorboat driver dropped us off here upon request. They have lots of tables with views of the Nile. We had no wait grabbing one. However because the restaurant was busy, waitstaffs were sometimes hard to get their attention. The food is good and fair priced for the location, ambiance and food offered. We ordered a hibiscus drink, guava juice, Nubian milk tea with cardamom, camel meat tagine, fried chicken and Nubian desert. The tamarind drink was not available at the time. Our total was 805 EGP for 2 person. Surprisingly our food came out within 15 minutes of ordering. I was expecting to wait an hour. The hibiscus drink was a bit too sweet for me. The milk tea was good and the guava juice was fresh. You can hear them blending the juices. The camel meat tagine was amazing. It tastes just like beef with no gamey taste at all and it was so tender. My fried chicken was actually a grilled leg of chicken. It didn’t have enough seasoning but the skin was crispy which I liked. The meals also came with a side of potatoes and peas tagine. They also came with a tomato and cucumber salad, which had a very light, to no dressing, bread, seasoned rice and tahina. The Nubian pie for dessert was just ok. It’s like puff pastry layered with sweet milk. It came out piping hot. It was not sweet enough though and could use some spice like cinnamon or cardamom to really take it up a notch. Their bathroom is clean. They had bug zappers which was nice. They also offer hookah. They take credit cards and I heard their breakfast is also good from another customer.
restaurant_name: King Jamaica restaurant & Cafe and breakfast ( Ayman jamaica ) ايمن جاميكا

This place is a real Italian gem on a relatively quiet street. After having Egyptian food at least once a day for the past 5 days, we decided to look for some other cuisine to try, and thus stumbled across Pizza Roma. The service was great, the ambience perfect for a quiet dinner, and the food Mamma Mia! was simply superb! So much that we dined there 2 nights in a row. Here's what we ordered and loved - Penne Arrabiata, Profondo Rosso pizza, Quatro Cami pizza, Speciale Piccante pizza. The portion size is perfect and we love how they could further spice up our dishes on our request. All in all, we highly recommend them to everyone visiting Luxor! Vegetarian options: They have lots of vegetarian options in pizzas and pastas, as well in appetizers.

Okay, so I’m not too keen on Sea Food but this was easily one of the best restaurants I visited on my trip through Egypt. I didn’t pick a meal from the menu, but I was asked to hand pick from a selection of fresh fish! The interior is great, colored lanterns cast dancing shapes as the wind gently pushes them. And just like the other restaurants the sea view is great. The food was expertly prepared and I was given everything I needed to enjoy the fish to the fullest. I wish every restaurant provided a whole bowl of lemons to season the food with! The service was impeccable, with tea on the house, a traditional Egyptian hand washing session and even a plant sprayer to deter hungry cats from snatching your meal. In conclusion: this was the best seafood I ever had in my life. I quite some time after my meal to keep enjoying the atmosphere and if I had more days in Dahab I’d definitely come back for more!

We went to Shark since it's ranked the highest amongst the sea line restaurants. Instead of choosing dishes from the menu (that would probably be a bit cheaper) we took the waiter's advice (he calls himself Shahar after an Israeli comedian that looks like him), and took a 2 Kg Seafood platter of 250g fresh lobster, 250g octopus, 250g calamari, and some 12 prawns, half grilled and half sauteed. We paid 2000 Egp. The dish was big and very tasty, a bit overcooked to my personal opinion but well seasoned. There are a couple of very recommended seafood places that are not on the sea line so they focus only on the level of food, but sitting above the waterline and watching the full moon shimmering on the water definitely made a difference. Recommended, and they have no hidden costs like other places do (billing for the bread and salads). Kid-friendliness: The team was very nice to the girls Wheelchair accessibility: The have a ramp and broad passage between the tables

If you're in the Dahab area and looking for a seafood restaurant, look no further than this gem that my wife and I have found. We keep coming back because the food is always fresh and incredibly delicious. The seafood options are particularly noteworthy - it's clear that the chefs only use the freshest ingredients, and the taste reflects that. I highly recommend trying the homemade pasta (seafood pasta or royal seafood pasta) as well - it's a standout dish that's cooked to perfection. One thing that sets this restaurant apart is the service. The staff are friendly, welcoming, and attentive to detail. They go out of their way to make sure you're comfortable and satisfied with your meal. If you're still hungry after your main course, I highly recommend the Apple Crumble - it's a perfect ending to a delicious meal. While you're waiting for your main course, the restaurant serves a series of small plates with different toppings to put on a piece of freshly-baked bread. It's a nice touch that keeps you from getting bored while you wait for your meal. Finally, if you're a seafood lover, you'll appreciate the restaurant's display of the day's catch. You can choose the exact seafood you want, which is then expertly prepared by the chefs. While this seafood restaurant is truly exceptional, it's worth mentioning that there is one potential downside: cats. While the restaurant itself is clean and well-maintained, there are cats that sometimes lurk around the outdoor seating area. This can be a bit distracting or even upsetting, especially if you're not a fan of cats or simply allergic. In fact, during our last visit, one of these cats tried to steal my wife's shrimp and ended up scratching me when I tried to intervene (help, in fact). While this was a bit of a negative experience, it's important to note that it didn't ruin our overall enjoyment of the meal. Additionally, it's worth noting that if you're planning on visiting this restaurant during busy Israeli public holidays or any other holiday, it's highly recommended to reserve a table in advance due to the high demand. This is a popular spot among tourists, so it's important to plan ahead if you want to ensure you have a table. Overall, this seafood restaurant is a must-visit for anyone in the Dahab area. The food is exceptional, the service is warm and attentive, and the atmosphere is perfect for a special occasion or a casual night out.

Sofra is my favourite restaurant in Egypt without question. The food and drink is flavourful and delicious, and everything they give you is completely fresh. Id throughly recommend the Tagin Lahma Bil Kawerma (Veal and pearl onion Tagin) and Shakshuka for mains among other amazing options. Definitely try the Sahlab (an Egyptian drink made from milk, orchids and nuts) or the range of fresh fruit juices to drink. The atmosphere is lovely. The top floor where we ate is naturally airy (helped at your discretion by fan and air conditioner) and cool, and the decor and furniture are beautiful. The waiters are friendly and attentive, and will answer any question asked in English. Absolutely a must visit if you’re in Luxor and want to experience Egyptian cuisine.

Don't the wipe their table after each customer? I certainly wouldn't recommend this place. Wheelchair accessibility: None. Stairs even to the ground floor dining area.

It's definitely a must-visit restaurant, very close to the Nile! Whenever we are back, we will definitely be dining again here.

This place was amazing. Cannot recommend enough, the staff were so friendly and professional, we were never with an empty glass or extinguished Shisha, It was our last night in Hurghada so we decided to go to a fancy restaurant for drinks, dinner and Shisha, the location was very nice with a view to the beach and the Red Sea, we ordered a red wine, an Alabama Slammer and two fresh juices (orange and a guava) My friend was happy with the wine and with it being my first time trying Egyptian wine I was pleasantly surprised, The Slammer was close to perfect and set me up grandly for dinner, The juices were both very fresh and cold. Onto dinner I thought I would try the Paella, It was out of this world, A delightful Egyptian spin on a Spanish classic, was extremely happy with this, and as my friend and I were having seafood we went for the Ayam white wine, it was very good and went down a little too easy even though I am not usually fond of white wine, after a delicious meal we moved back out to the balcony for another bottle of Ayam and a Shisha, The Shisha was the best I’ve tried and lasted a nice long session, Kareem was very attentive and mixed a lovely Shisha and we weren’t without a smoke the rest of the evening, after being there about 5 hours in total and a bottle of wine each we decided to move on to a nightclub so out came the bill and I was very surprised at how so well priced the evening was, between the two of us the total came to about E£4500 (about £40/$50 each) for this type of service, quality and location/atmosphere I would have gladly paid double, this place is not to be missed if you are in Hurghada, Shout out to Harry who made us very welcome 100/100

Totally , The place is excellent , serving real Authentic Turkish Food , Extremely Clean , Prices are above average as expected -with few notes on some side items & desserts prices- but generally acceptable , considering the high quality food and the professional, fast, helpful and friendly team working in this beautiful and beautiful vibes . Very Recommended to visit , and definitely we will come again ISA.

Nestled in the heart of Doha, Trader Vic's offers an exquisite dining experience that is truly unparalleled. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that this was a high-end establishment, boasting an elegant ambience and a menu that reflects its upscale nature. The highlight of our visit was undoubtedly the food. We had a specific request for our dishes to be prepared extra spicy, and the attention to detail was impeccable. The manager himself came to our table to confirm our preference, ensuring that our culinary experience was tailored to our tastes. This personal touch set the tone for the evening, showcasing their commitment to customer satisfaction. Each dish we ordered was a symphony of flavours, expertly crafted and beautifully presented. The spice level was exactly as requested, adding an exciting kick without overpowering the nuanced flavours of the cuisine. It was evident that the chefs at Trader Vic's take great pride in their work, resulting in dishes that are both creative and delicious. The staff were exemplary, providing attentive and knowledgeable service throughout our meal. Their professionalism and enthusiasm enhanced our dining experience, making us feel well-cared for from start to finish. Their ability to provide detailed information about the menu and make thoughtful recommendations was greatly appreciated. In conclusion, Trader Vic's in Doha is a top-tier restaurant that delivers on all fronts. From the sophisticated setting to the flawless execution of the dishes, it is a destination for those seeking a memorable dining experience. While the menu is on the pricier side, the quality of the food and the outstanding service make it worth every riyal. If you're in Doha and looking for a place to indulge in a luxurious meal, Trader Vic's is the perfect choice.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting MADO, a Turkish restaurant located in the Pearl, and overall, I was quite impressed with my experience. The restaurant boasts a cozy atmosphere, with stylish decor that transports you to Turkey. The service was excellent, with friendly staff who were attentive and made sure my dining experience was enjoyable. Now, let's talk about the food. I decided to try their breakfast menu, and while it was quite pricey, it was definitely worth it. The standout dish for me was the traditional Turkish breakfast platter, which was a combination of various cheeses, olives, honey, and bread. It was a delightful feast for the senses and left me feeling satisfied and happy. However, there were a couple of downsides to my experience that prevented me from giving MADO a perfect rating. Firstly, the prices were quite steep, which may not be affordable for everyone. Additionally, the portion sizes were on the smaller side, so I didn't feel like I got as much food as I would have liked for the price I paid. Overall, I would highly recommend MADO to anyone who's looking for a unique dining experience in the Pearl. The food is delicious, the service is great, and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. Just be prepared to spend a little more money than you would at other breakfast spots in the area. I give it a solid 4 stars out of 5.

The staff were on point, offering informative and friendly service that greatly enhanced our visit. Their knowledge of the menu and thoughtful recommendations were particularly appreciated. In conclusion, Asha's in Doha is a culinary gem that delivers an exceptional Indian dining experience. The combination of authentic flavours, high-end quality spices, and outstanding service makes it a standout choice for anyone craving Indian cuisine. Whether you're a local or a visitor exploring Villagio Mall, Asha's is a must-visit destination for a memorable meal.

My recent visit to Basta Restaurant Qatar with my friend Rhys, who hails from East Asia, was nothing short of spectacular. We sampled two dishes, Sheykh Al Fareij and Machboos, and were blown away by the culinary prowess showcased in each plate. First and foremost, the food at Basta Restaurant is simply incredible. It ranks among my top dining experiences, thanks to the exceptional flavors and quality ingredients. The Sheykh Al Fareij and Machboos were both cooked to perfection, with the meat being a standout element that left us speechless. The ambiance of the restaurant is noteworthy as well. Adorned with captivating posters and pictures from bygone eras, Basta Restaurant exudes a charming and nostalgic vibe. We opted to sit outside, enjoying the pleasant weather, but I would recommend indoor seating during the summer months to avoid discomfort. We complemented our meal with Leban, a drink reminiscent of what we call Dough in my country. The refreshing taste added to our overall dining satisfaction. The rice accompanying our dishes was cooked impeccably, adding a delightful texture to each bite. One aspect that stood out was the presentation of the food. The way the dishes were served showcased a blend of aesthetics and attention to detail, enhancing our dining experience. To top it off, the visit from a restaurant supervisor added a personal touch. Their inquiry about our satisfaction with the food and the staff’s hospitality further emphasized the restaurant’s commitment to customer satisfaction. In conclusion, dining at Basta Restaurant Qatar was an absolute pleasure. We left the restaurant with content hearts and happy taste buds, thoroughly enjoying every aspect of our experience. I highly recommend Basta Restaurant to anyone looking for a memorable culinary journey filled with exquisite flavors and a welcoming atmosphere.

The Cheesecake Factory offers a delightful dining experience with a wide variety of options that cater to diverse tastes. During my recent visit, I was impressed by the expansive menu that spans multiple cuisines, ensuring there's something for everyone. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with a stylish yet comfortable decor. The lighting and seating arrangements create a pleasant atmosphere perfect for both casual outings and special occasions. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure we felt welcomed and taken care of throughout our meal. For appetizers, we tried the Avocado Eggrolls and Fried Macaroni and Cheese. Both were delicious and set the stage for what was to come. For our main courses, we opted for a variety of vegetarian dishes. The Veggie Tacos were flavorful and well-seasoned, with fresh ingredients that made every bite enjoyable. The Vegan Cobb Salad was a standout, packed with a medley of vegetables and a tangy dressing that tied everything together perfectly. Evelyn’s Favorite Pasta was a hearty and satisfying dish, loaded with vegetables and a light garlic sauce. The Veggie Burger was also excellent, with a well-seasoned patty and a delicious blend of toppings. The highlight, of course, was the cheesecake. We chose the Oreo Dream Extreme Cheesecake and it did not disappoint. The rich, creamy texture combined with the crunchy Oreo pieces was heavenly. It was the perfect ending to our meal. We walked in without a reservation and experienced a wait time of about 15-20 minutes. While this was a bit of an inconvenience, it was understandable given the restaurant’s popularity. Additionally, while the portion sizes are generous, the prices are on the higher side, making it a bit pricey for regular dining. Overall, The Cheesecake Factory provides a fantastic dining experience with delicious food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. It’s a wonderful place to enjoy a meal with family and friends, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining outing.

Both were delicious and set the stage for what was to come. For our main courses, we opted for a variety of vegetarian dishes. The Veggie Tacos were flavorful and well-seasoned, with fresh ingredients that made every bite enjoyable. The Vegan Cobb Salad was a standout, packed with a medley of vegetables and a tangy dressing that tied everything together perfectly. Evelyn’s Favorite Pasta was a hearty and satisfying dish, loaded with vegetables and a light garlic sauce. The Veggie Burger was also excellent, with a well-seasoned patty and a delicious blend of toppings. The highlight, of course, was the cheesecake. We chose the Oreo Dream Extreme Cheesecake and it did not disappoint. The rich, creamy texture combined with the crunchy Oreo pieces was heavenly. It was the perfect ending to our meal. We walked in without a reservation and experienced a wait time of about 15-20 minutes. While this was a bit of an inconvenience, it was understandable given the restaurant’s popularity. Additionally, while the portion sizes are generous, the prices are on the higher side, making it a bit pricey for regular dining. Overall, The Cheesecake Factory provides a fantastic dining experience with delicious food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. It’s a wonderful place to enjoy a meal with family and friends, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining outing.

I recently visited Cheesecake Factory at Villagio Mall after a day’s work at Khalifa International Stadium, and I must say it was a satisfying experience. The location of the restaurant within the mall made it easily accessible, and the short walk from the stadium was convenient. Upon arrival, we were greeted at the welcome desk and promptly seated at a prepared table. The efficiency was appreciated. We opted for Spaghetti with Meatballs and Fish and Chips along with 2 servings of Coke Zero. The spaghetti, though presented beautifully, had a rather ordinary taste. The meatballs, however, were unexpectedly large, which was a pleasant surprise. The highlight of our meal was the Fish and Chips, which were exceptionally delicious. The flavors were spot on, making it the standout dish of our visit. One notable aspect was the refillable soda, allowing us to enjoy unlimited drinks throughout our meal. Before the main dishes, we were served two types of fresh bread with butter, which we thoroughly enjoyed. Overall, Cheesecake Factory offers a good dining experience with a diverse menu selection. While some dishes may be average, others like the Fish and Chips make up for it, ensuring a satisfying visit.

This restaurant has been a go to place for me and my friends for almost 8 years now to get great Turkish food. They have great selection of barbeques and kebabs. The bbq chicken is very juicy and their shwarma with sauces too hits the perfect note. The appetizers too are well made and garnished. A special mention for their buhaari rice as it's certainly unique to this restaurant and haven't had such taste in any other Turkish restaurant in Qatar. The ambience isn't fancy, however is kept clean and hygienic. They have a separate small section for families too. The service is quick and pleasant. They bring your orders to your car too for take away. Lastly , Tahsim and Saif , the owners are more like friends and eager to serve you good food with smile just like their father did few years ago. Do visit for good Turkish food. You will not be left disappointed. Wheelchair accessibility: Wheelchair can't access

You’re slowly biting into a piece of Sambousek covered in Hummus, with some Hindbeh leaves in the mix… You close your eyes to savor the moment as you let the explosion of flavors invade you. A nostalgic Fairuz song is playing in the background, and a soft breeze is caressing your cheeks. Life is good. It’s especially good at Em Sherif where the culinary experience combines richness and delicateness, comfort and elegance, past and present. A word of caution: you may have to roll out of the place, as walking would be physically impossible after what can only be described as a gargantuan feast… So you may want to pace yourself. It’s a set menu that takes the stress out of ordering, and ensures that energy is re-directed towards devouring the meal. And it’s classically Lebanese, with the cold and hot appetizers, the warm main dishes, and the desserts, all with small refined portions. Everything was delicious but if I were to pick some highlights: - The minced meat Rkakat and Sambousek were so scrumptious yet delicate at the same time - The Kibbeh with yogurt is another hit. The flavoring, the umami, the freshness of the yoghurt…combine magically together - Then when you think you’re done… comes a pleasant surprise: A muffin-shaped puff pastry filled with rice, minced meat, chicken and a whole array of condiments (raisins, almonds, shaved carrots, peas), sprinkled with a cinnamon flavored gravy… Sort of a “Riz aa Djej” with a twist. You won’t know what hit you. And you might come back for a second, third, maybe even a fourth serving. - The desserts.. what a beautiful note to end this extraordinary performance on. The date and molasses cake might trigger a few inappropriate sounds of approval. The Mhallabye with the loukoum and biscuits will feel decadently sinful. It’s a beautiful experience. Yes your tummy will beg you to stop, but your your heart and soul will beg for an Encore…

Jeeda's has one of the nicest atmospheres I've seen in any upscale restaurant in Alexanderia. The decor is very pleasing to the eye, the music is enjoyable without being intrusive, and the seats are quite comfortable. The staff are incredibly nice and helpful. Every member of staff we talked to was very very nice to us and we would like to thank each of them personally. That said, the food was quite underwhelming. We went at a time where it was quite quiet, so there was no rush, but the food was barely good nonetheless. I ordered Pollo Al Ajillo, which arrived barely lukewarm. The chicken breasts were overcooked and chalky. The dish was also bland, but I presume that's because they want their customers to salt their plates to taste, so there is no shame about that (fresh pepper and salt were provided at the table). The french fries side was excellent. Beautifully crisp on the outside and fluffy on the inside. I also got a strawberry watermelon lemonade, which was definitely really good too. I paid about 500 EGP total, which I find to be quite steep for overcooked chicken.

Our first time at Steak Bar Sushi was nice. The place looks great and has a cool, fancy feel with good music. The food was okay in quality but the portions were small and the taste was just average. We started with the Raunchy Mushroom, which was okay but not great, so I'd give it a 3 out of 5. We also tried six skewers, which were better, earning a 4 out of 5. The five sushi sets we had were alright, scoring 3 out of 5, with the Crazy Salmon being the best of them. The ribs we ordered weren't good – the taste, quality, and amount were all disappointing, so 2 out of 5 for them. The Bife de Ancho steak was much better, with a tasty sauce, getting a 4 out of 5 from us. We also had two sides of Messy Potato, which were good and get a 4 out of 5. We each had a glass of wine to drink. For dessert, we chose the Chocolate Orgasm and Caramelized Pineapple, which were good, scoring 4/5 and 3/5. In total, six of us ate and the bill was about $200. Overall, the place is nice to look at and the food is alright, However it's over rated and expensive for what you get, especially because the portions aren't big.

Yes, it was all the hype about Em Sherif and their high review scores that eventually aroused my curiosity. We were in the mood for Lebanese cuisine, so we decided to finally give it a try. When you go in, you notice that the restaurant is fancy, with its mirrored tables and silver cutlery (although I liked some aspects of the interior decoration more than others). A noteworthy issue to mention here is that the service was great from when we entered Em Sherif till when we left. The waiters were very welcoming and friendly, and swiftly brought the food to our table. Things work differently at Em Sherif; when you sit down you do not get a menu to choose from but instead the food directly starts coming your way. For a first-timer, the set menu descending at a fast pace in front of you as well as the waiters passing by with trays of food can be exciting, yet a bit overwhelming as you are trying to keep track of what is being offered and trying to taste everything. However, we did request for room to breathe when we were asked if we would like the hot constituents to be served. I am glad we did that because it was then that I enjoyed all the delicious flavors. Em Sherif does have great food. Their hummus is creamy and their humble labne is really really really good. From the items on the “hovering mezza” tray, the la7em bi3ajeen and sambousik were very tasty, and honestly I would rather that the tray land on the table permanently. The chickpeas in the balila were cooked perfectly and it was well seasoned, though a tad oily. I was surprised at how good the harak osbao was; it had the right amount of tanginess. Additionally, the marination of the skewered shrimps was great and I enjoyed the tender meat chunks (I preferred them to the chich taouk). I could go and on about the immense number of platters we tasted, but if I wanted to describe Em Sherif’s food concisely, it would be well-balanced; their seasoning and the combination of flavors were spot on. I also have to commend them on the kibbe nayye, which had the mint and onions within the mixture, meaning all you had to do was add the olive oil. After this feast of salted dishes, it was time for the sweet ones. Their um ali sauce is to die for! I loved their take on the foret noire presentation; it was placed in a bowl and the chocolate cake was in itself a moist hollow vessel in which the fruits and cream were placed. It seems the maamoul bi jibne is popping up everywhere nowadays, and I am a fan of it in general, and a fan of it at Em Sherif. The waiter places it on your plate and professionally slits it open so that the drizzle of syrup reaches the melted cheese beneath the crumbly crust. All in all, Em Sherif provides a rich set menu with a bit of everything and it left us feeling stuffed for the rest of the day.

The dining experience and atmosphere during Eid were outstanding. Despite not having a reservation, they promptly seated us outside overlooking the marina. The drinks were expertly crafted with minimal sugar, and we enjoyed freshly baked bread. The chicken samosas were uniquely delicious with pine seed stuffing and served with a flavorful sauce. The whole grilled chicken was tender and perfectly cooked, though the portion size was quite generous for one person, suitable for sharing among three. While the lamb kebabs were juicy and flavorful, I noticed a distinct aroma typical of lamb meat, which some restaurants manage to mitigate effectively. I'm uncertain if this applies to all lamb dishes, as I've dined at restaurants where this aroma is not noticeable. Some might find the typical lamb aroma slightly off-putting. Despite this, the portions were generous, and the service was exceptional. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking a fine dining experience in Qatar.

Yasmine Palace has to be one of the most beautiful restaurants we have ever visited! The location on The Pearl is stunning with indoor and outdoor seating available and beautiful twinkling lights everywhere. We chose to dine outdoors as it was a beautiful warm evening in December (being from the UK, this was a real treat!) We had been craving kunefa whilst on holiday so our hotel concierge recommended we try here and we were so glad that we did. It took us around 10mins in a taxi to get here from the city centre and once we arrived and saw the opulent restaurant, we knew we were in for a treat! For such a vast restaurant, the service we received was efficient, professional and friendly. I have to particularly mention our waiters Devakee and Amit who were great. Also, the restaurant manager Wael Hamdan was so warm, welcoming and helpful that I wish all hospitality staff could be this way! Thank you for your kindness- it was very much appreciated. The food was outstanding and we loved the complimentary appetisers that were brought out to us on a golden serving dish… breads, crackers, vegetables and several different types of hummus- all absolutely delicious and a wonderful way to start our meal and get our tastebuds tingling. We were also given 2 small glasses of fruit juices served in delightful crystal glasses which were very refreshing and a great palate cleanser. My husband and I opted for several dishes to share including cheese samosas, hummus with meat, moussaka and grilled halloumi - it was all heavenly and we really couldn’t decide which dish we enjoyed the most as it was all fantastic. We then finished our meal with tea (served on the most lovely golden platter with biscuits) the amazing kunefa which I cannot recommend highly enough and a strawberry milkshake which was again, simply divine! We were then treated to some live traditional music which was a lovely way to end our special evening here. Once you have finished your meal I would encourage you to take a wander around the restaurant to discover all of the ornate intricacies that make this place so special. Then walk along the Pearl to take in the lovely scenery and boats bopping around in the marina (some are rather spectacular!) Please accept our heartfelt thanks to Wael and all of the wonderful team at Yasmine Palace for the most memorable evening. We would not hesitate to return again the next time we are in Doha 🙏

From the moment we stepped through the door, we were greeted with warm smiles and a welcoming atmosphere. The first thing that struck me was the elegant ambiance of the restaurant. The flavors were exceptional, and it was evident that the ingredients used were of the highest quality. They guided us through the menu, offering valuable recommendations and explaining each dish in detail. Our glasses were never empty, and our needs were anticipated and catered to throughout the evening. The level of professionalism and genuine hospitality demonstrated by the staff was truly commendable.

Contemporary fine-dine restaurant established by our beloved Asha Bhosle. The rich spices and aroma of the food was unmatched. The tender meat slipping through our fingers and melting in our mouth is a moment to experience. I couldn’t get over their Pressure cooked Lamb curry along with a bowl of Jasmine rice which was suggested by our host. Its a must try, REALLY. The lamb was cooked to everyone’s liking and the aromatic curry filled our hearts. The Murgh Kalimirch had soft chicken pieces with crispy onions and as we had ordered mild spicy dishes, they had done a pretty good job. Along with the two gravy based dishes, we ordered a naan basket which consisted of garlic butter naan, butter naan, roti and plain naan. As a rice option, we weren’t sure we would finish it. But it was sooo delicious and yummmm, we couldn’t help it but completely finished the kadai😂 We had ordered Kesar Mutton Biryani. The caramelised onions and tender mutton pieces cooked along with kesari milk not giving a sweet base but a mild spicy one was just perfect. They have their restaurants in a mall setting so its not much of quiet and peace but they do have good seating arrangements and decor in their space. I have come across their restaurant in Villagio and Doha Festival City. The hosts are happy to serve you and have really suggestions, so don’t forget to ask them.

I went twice during February. Once during their valentine's special set menu with my parents, and the other just on a regular day with friends. On the valentine's day it was busy so its understandable there were some delays during their servings. Overall it was lovely and our server Ms. Rogelyn was very accomodating, bring our dishes and answering any questions about the food. The decorations for valentine's was very pretty there were balloons, roses and petals if requested and even heart confetti. Their set menu was very generous, having an apetiser, meat bbq, sushi, and dessert. The food quality was delicious and even if there was some delays in serving due to the busyness this did not impact. My partner and mother-in-law who's first time it was trying Yeehwa were very impressed and want to visit again. The other time I went with my friend was a quiet dinner, we had a-la-carte bbq set since it was not bbq buffet day. This is a generous serving portion for 2, possibly even 3 people since you can choose a dish or a set of sushi roll to go with it. Our server Ms. Marge was very sweet and accomodating as she helped us navigate the new menu, which had some price changes but worth it. She also helped with installing and registering the new app for points and registering there to claim for next time. A very useful thing for frequent Yeehwa visitors. Overall 10/10 experience with a great staff!
